title: A Prefix Census of 3n+c and 5n+1 Cycles, with One Verified Collatz Delay-Record Instance

description: Cryptographically hashed prefix census of periodic orbits for 3n+c (c = +1, -1, +5) and 5n+1, proof of the sign-conjugacy theorem C_{-c}(n) = -C_c(-n), and exact 1348-step trajectory verification of the maximal Collatz delay-record start below 10^{12}, n = 989,345,275,647 (peak 1,219,624,271,099,764 < 2^{53}-1).
